Name: CP - Foxbloom Seeds
Author: CrypticHaze
Description:
Everyone is saying this mod should not be made but I'll ask you how it's any different than using CJB Item Spawner. I'm not adding it to any shops you have to use CJB Item Spawner just to get the seeds. So, you already have the ability to spawn anything else without ever growing a Foxbloom and at iridium quality no less. This actually seems like less of a cheat than just giving yourself 999 Foxbloom honey of iridium quality at least that's how I see it. That said I'm not here to step on anyone's toes and apologize for any hard feelings. This is a mod, made for those of us that just want to have fun without limitations. I don't know about you, but I use cheats cause it's fun to see the pinnacle of what can be. There is enough limitations in real life I have no place for more in my games. Hope you enjoy . . .

Edit: It seems these seeds will also be produced from the seed maker if you put a Foxbloom in it as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6279280]Norabbitz[/url] brought to my attention. So, if you don't want to use CJB Item Spawner there's another option.

When upgrading from 0.5 to the full version 1.0 please delete and reinstall [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25788]Ridgeside Forage Crops[/url] normally. Also all curently planted Foxbloom will default to RSV Foxblooms and any seeds will become useless placeholders. I would make sure to plant and grow all seeds to maturity then uninstall/reinstall [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25788]Ridgeside Forage Crops[/url] after word install Foxbloom Seeds and if you would like to keep the Foxblooms as seeds feed them into a seed maker after upgrade is finished.

Downloads.Description: compatible with seed maker and harvest with Scythe to prevent accidental picking
